d: The Compliance Manager will support the CCO & MLRO in managing day-to-day operations of Qatar Compliance unit, ensuring compliance to Bank’s AML/KYC policies/procedures and Regulatory requirements in Qatar (QCB) while representing the Bank in Qatar on all AML/CFT/Sanctions compliance and regulatory compliance related matters and extend managerial assistance on all such matters to the CCO & MLRO

Support CCO and MLRO to maintain contact with QCB and other regulatory authorities/agencies to ensure a good and healthy working relationship exists – facilitate/coordinate between Branches and QCB as necessary – seeking guidance from IBG-Compliance as appropriate.
Support CCO and MLRO in ensuring Bank’s internal procedures/policies remain compliant with regulations/changes – providing guidance/advice to Branch Management as necessary.
Maintain pro-active relationships with business, facilitating timely involvement to ensure compliant solutions to business issues.
Promptly communicate all Regulatory Notices/Circulars to all concerned areas, providing accurate Arabic/English translations as necessary.
Promptly escalate any high risk issues/violations/breaches to CCO & MLRO and IBG-Compliance and develop/monitor action plans for closure of the same.
Support in developing/maintaining/updating the local Compliance/AML Manual and ensuring a copy is provided to all Branch Staff.

Providing support to CCO and MLRO in AML/Compliance Training to all Qatar staff on an ongoing basis as required/necessary to raise awareness and ensure all staff understand their responsibilities/obligations with regard to Corporate/AML Policies and regulatory/legal/statutory requirements, etc.
Encourage a strong compliance culture/environment in Qatar branches.
Promote the self-identification and reporting of all compliance issues (capturing same on MERs) and sharing of issues that may have wider implications.
Ensure that all Qatar Product Programs, SOPs etc. are in compliance with QCB requirements as well as Mashreqbank’s AML/KYC Policy - and that transactions are monitored accordingly.

Analyze suspicious transactions reported by units/branches, undertake investigations where required, and support the MLRO in submitting (as appropriate) STR (Suspicious Transaction Report) to QCB in a timely manner with complete and accurate information.

Respond in a timely manner to Compliance/AML/Sanctions related queries/investigations of QCB/HO/Other Regulators/Law Enforcement Agencies, as well as provide expert guidance to branches/units upon referrals/queries.
Liaise and support IBG-Compliance in implementation of Bank’s/Regulator’s Compliance Policies/Requirements and roll-out of related systems/initiatives across Qatar branches.
7-10 years banking experience with good understanding of products/operations environment, in particular as regards US and Qatar.
Professional qualification in business / commerce / economics / law.
Sound knowledge of international banking / practice and products / services.
Specific and / or transferable knowledge / experience related to compliance / AML / Sanctions / Central Bank regulations.
Computer literate and strong command of written and spoken English. Arabic is an advantage

r: Prepares material takeoffs on the most complex projects, drawings, and plans. Reviews takeoffs provided by the Engineering Department and checks for mathematical and technical accuracy.

d: We are looking for a commercially minded Marketing Manager to own our full 360° marketing strategy across online and offline channels, for both B2B and B2C audiences. This role is for a business builder: someone who links every marketing decision to revenue, market share and brand growth, and who can take the business to its next stage of growth.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field; MBA is a plus.
8–10+ years of marketing experience, including at least 3–4 years in a management role.
Proven track record of delivering 360° campaigns across both online and offline channels.
Hands-on experience in both B2B and B2C marketing.
Demonstrated results in growing revenue, market share or entering new markets.
Strong business acumen: understands P&L, commercial drivers and how marketing creates value.
Strategic thinker who can also execute and get into the detail.
Data-driven: confident with analytics, dashboards and performance reporting (e.g. Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, CRM tools).
Digital expertise: performance marketing, SEO/SEM, social media, content and marketing automation.
Leadership: builds high-performing teams and manages agencies effectively.
Excellent communicator in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management with senior leadership and sales teams.
What Success Looks Like in the First Year
A clear, approved marketing strategy with KPIs linked to business targets.
Measurable growth in qualified leads and marketing-driven revenue.
A stronger, more consistent brand across all channels.
An efficient marketing budget with clear ROI reporting.
A capable, motivated marketing team and a reliable agency network.
r: Build and own the annual marketing strategy and plan, aligned with business targets and growth priorities.
Identify new markets, segments and revenue opportunities, and turn them into clear go-to-market plans.
Partner with leadership on pricing, positioning, product launches and expansion decisions.
Translate business goals into measurable marketing KPIs and report on ROI.
Lead integrated campaigns across digital, social media, search, email, content, PR, events, outdoor and print.
Drive performance marketing (paid search, paid social, programmatic) to generate qualified leads and sales.
Oversee website, SEO and marketing automation to improve conversion across the customer journey.
Plan and deliver offline activations: exhibitions, trade shows, sponsorships, in-store and on-ground events.
Develop account-based and lead-generation programs that support the sales pipeline.
Create sales enablement materials: company profiles, proposals, case studies and presentations.
Work closely with the sales team on lead quality, conversion and key account growth.
Grow brand awareness, customer acquisition and retention through targeted consumer campaigns.
Use customer insights and data to build segments, offers and loyalty initiatives.
Manage the brand voice and customer experience across all touchpoints.
Protect and strengthen the brand identity across all channels and markets.
Own the marketing budget and allocate spend to the channels with the best return.
Lead, coach and grow the marketing team, and manage agencies and suppliers.
Track market trends and competitor activity, and turn insights into action.
Revenue and pipeline generated or influenced by marketing
Lead volume, lead quality and cost per lead / acquisition
Brand awareness and share of voice
Customer acquisition, retention and lifetime value
Digital performance: traffic, engagement and conversion rates

d: WE ARE HIRING | PROJECT MANAGER – FIT-OUT
ARAS Fine Interiors L.L.C. is expanding its team!

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager – Interior Fit-Out with strong UAE market experience and a proven track record of independently managing fit-out projects from mobilization through execution, completion, and final handover.
We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong, and commercially aware professional with excellent leadership and project management skills.
q: Proven experience as a Project Manager in the UAE interior fit-out industry.
Strong experience independently delivering fit-out projects.
Excellent technical knowledge of finishes, joinery, construction, and MEP coordination.
Strong understanding of project planning, procurement, subcontractor management, and cost control.
Experience handling variations, claims, and commercial coordination.
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Interested candidates are requested to submit
Summary of completed UAE interior fit-out projects.
Major projects personally managed, including approximate contract values.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss a previously completed project, including project execution, challenges, programme, cost and variation management, subcontractor coordination, and final handover.
Important: Only candidates with proven UAE interior fit-out project management experience will be considered.
We look forward to welcoming the right professional to the ARAS Fine Interiors team!
r: Manage interior fit-out projects from award to final handover.
Lead site execution and coordinate clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, contracts, and project programmes.
Develop and monitor project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and progress.
Coordinate architectural, joinery, MEP, and specialist works.
Manage shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, RFIs, and technical approvals.
Coordinate procurement, long-lead items, and subcontract packages.
Monitor project costs, variations, productivity, quality, and programme.
Identify project risks and implement effective solutions to avoid delays.
Manage snagging, inspections, testing, handover, and project close-out.
